rules: Every official entry references authoritative source provenance.
Integration is idempotent by source event id plus record family.
Existing events are never modified/deleted by integration.
Corrections append a new correction/superseding event.
AI-generated summaries are non-authoritative derived presentation.
Academy graduation and discipline may bridge into career-wide service record under explicit mapping.
Year 4 completion alone cannot create graduation or commission.
Graduation alone cannot create first assignment.
Confirmed player graduation may create persistent Academy-completion unlock evidence.
Unlock evidence permits future campaign option logic but does not guarantee a first posting.
